keyword: who is going to the moon

verifications.claim: NASA has launched the four-person crew of Artemis II on a 10-day mission around the Moon in April 2026.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: Artemis II lifted off at 6:35 p.m. EDT (R1); '10-day voyage around the moon' (R5); '10-day mission' on April 1, 2026 (R6); '10-day journey around Earth and the moon' (R8)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm the launch date in April 2026, four-person crew, ~10-day duration, and mission around the Moon without landing.

verifications.claim: Artemis II marks the first human trip to lunar orbit in over 50 years.
verifications.label: INCORRECT
verifications.evidence: 'will not land on the moon or even go into lunar orbit. Instead, the plan is to loop around it' (R1); 'around the moon but not land there' (R3); 'fly around the Moon and head straight back to Earth' (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm first crewed lunar mission in 50+ years but explicitly state no lunar orbit; it's a flyby/loop around the Moon.
